question: May this PR merge with the Socket obfuscated-code warning for `@openclaw/feishu@2026.6.11` after source review, or should it wait for a clearer package/repack?
rationale: The warning is a supply-chain trust decision for an executable channel fixture package, and model review cannot safely accept that risk on the maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept After Source Review
options.body: A maintainer reviews the package/source provenance, accepts or triages the Socket warning, and proceeds after the manifest and proof blockers are fixed.

options.title: Wait For Repack Or Triage
options.body: Pause this PR until `@openclaw/feishu` is republished or the Socket alert is resolved upstream.
